The newspaper interviewed two different recently divorced people, one straight and the other lesbian, about their experiences in their first marriage. The straight one mentioned that they were the cause of the divorce after realizing that they really had no intention to remain monogamous, and the lesbian one said that their marriage had ended after their partner became distant but doesn't think either of them had trouble having just one partner. Who was comfortably monogamous?
A. The straight one
B. Cannot answer
C. The lesbian one
